title: His role in Cabin in the Sky
summary: He explains how he was cast as go-between for Rochester, Ethel Waters and Lena Horne, and tells the love-triangle plot.

blocks.x: How were you chosen for that picture? Was that Nazarro's booking?

Yeah. Well, the way I got in that show, someone called me in the theater and figured I would be just the one that could become the go-between Rochester, Lena Horne and Ethel Waters. So there was a love scene that they put up so that Rochester would be the husband of Ethel Waters and Lena Horne would be my lover and we get into an entanglement concerning the love affair, which we did, which I got hurt doing, but anyway I
Wait a second. Could you explain --

I'm going to do that. So -- the picture was very good and the idea was good because Lena Horne was my girlfriend and Ethel Waters was Rochester's wife. So Rochester played the Sweepstakes and he won and Buck was the messenger who brought him the telegram that he won the Sweepstakes and he took the money he won the Sweepstakes with and took Lena Horne out. That's my girl he's taking out now but Ethel Waters don't know he's got the money and is going to take her out. So Ethel Waters is going to find out where he went and so am I going to find out where Lena Horne is. So we all meet in a cabaret, unbeknownst to each other, like you find somebody in a cabaret, didn't know they were going to be there.
